title: Deployed password-reset request and actual email delivery
expected: Reset request reaches the generic confirmation page and reset instructions arrive at the controlled registered inbox.

actual.heading: Check Your Email
actual.message: If an eligible account exists with the email address you entered, password-reset instructions will be sent to that address.
actual.elapsed_wait: User reported indefinite; exact duration not recorded

visual_review: Screenshot confirms generic reset-request confirmation and expected URL; it does not prove token generation or email delivery.
limitations: No measured delivery deadline or elapsed duration is available.
Deployed email backend, account/email match and provider logs have not been verified.
Cause is unknown; console-backend configuration is a possibility, not an established finding.
Separate CI expiry defect is not proved or disproved by this delivery observation.
next_action: Developer verifies deployed email backend and matching QA account/email, then delivery/provider logs; retry once with recorded timestamps after prerequisite is established.
disposition: User deferred email-backend investigation; retain as unresolved delivery shortcoming and blocked reset journey, not a pass. Root cause unconfirmed.
